correctness.rationale: The exact full-context closure uses all unary and ordered binary images of every reachable subset. Eleven non-singleton masks occur singly in order, then exactly one singleton first occurs at height 11. An explicit 12-independent-leaf term reaches it. The universal bound follows by strict-growth counting, and the one-symbol restriction by trapping all non-variable images in the first operation image. The standalone certificate was run and checked.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial four-state sharpness frontier for the universal strong tree reset bound is settled at the smallest possible alphabet: one unary and one binary ranked symbol. The witness visits all non-singleton subsets before synchronizing, showing genuinely binary behavior outside the LCM-based construction. This determines a naturally motivated exact extremum and alphabet threshold, though it supplies no all-n lower bound.
